display.purpose: General h1 headings, including homepage and documentation; responsive overrides are in DESIGN.md.

body.purpose: Reading text; becomes 18px at 600px and below.

lede.purpose: Documentation introductions; homepage uses a larger contextual variant.

label.purpose: Bold labels above form controls, following responsive body size.

button.purpose: Bold ordinary action labels; contextual and mobile variants are in DESIGN.md.

small.purpose: Helper text, footer links and installer support details.

wordmark.purpose: OpenAthan brand link; no separate brand symbol.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The main action in the current task.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 30px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #355e83); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent, #355e83); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #254764); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #254764); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #355e83); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-primary { font-size: 1.15rem; padding-inline: 22px; } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: A supporting action such as Back or Find networks.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 30px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #355e83); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent, #355e83); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #254764); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #254764); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #355e83); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #355e83); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--panel, #eff3f7); color: var(--accent-hover, #254764); } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-secondary { font-size: 1.15rem; padding-inline: 22px; } }

components.name: Unavailable action
components.description: Disabled primary and secondary controls retain a distinct pale fill.
components.css: .ds-disabled { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 30px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #355e83); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent, #355e83); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disabled:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #254764); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #254764); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-disabled:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #355e83); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-disabled:disabled { background: var(--panel, #eff3f7); color: var(--muted, #526171); border-color: var(--field-border, #7b8896); cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-disabled { font-size: 1.15rem; padding-inline: 22px; } }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A full-width field with a preceding bold label.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-network">Network name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-network" type="text" value="Home Wi-Fi" />
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: block; color: var(--text, #38434f); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 700; margin: 20px 0 5px; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 760px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--field-border, #7b8896); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #38434f); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; caret-color: var(--accent, #355e83); } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--panel, #eff3f7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #355e83); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-label, .ds-input { font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Visible links with a current-page or current-section underline.
components.html: DocumentationGitHubUSB setup
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-nav a { padding-block: 12px; color: var(--accent, #355e83); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 0.16em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current], .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent-hover, #254764); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #355e83); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 800px) { .ds-nav { gap: 20px; } } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-nav { width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-nav a { padding-block: 8px; } }

components.name: Supporting panel
components.description: Flat supporting content, such as setup help or contribution guidance.
components.html:
Before you connect

This installer supports AtomS3R C126 + Pyramid A167.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; padding: 24px; background: var(--panel, #eff3f7); color: var(--text, #38434f); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--ink, #202c3a); font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.12; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-panel strong { font-weight: 700; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-panel { font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Availability notice
components.description: An amber notice that explains availability or a caution.
components.html:
New installation is unavailable.

You can still connect an existing OpenAthan to open its settings or fix Wi-Fi and its device password.
components.css: .ds-notice { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--warning-bg, #fff5e6); color: var(--warning-text, #805719); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-notice strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-notice p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text, #38434f); } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-notice { font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Documentation destination
components.description: A full-width reading link with a title, description and bottom rule.
components.html: Getting startedFind the parts you need and follow the setup instructions.
components.css: .ds-doc-link { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; display: block; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d6dee6); color: var(--accent, #355e83); text-decoration: none; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-doc-link strong { display: block; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.16em; } .ds-doc-link span { display: block; color: var(--text, #38434f); margin-top: 8px; } .ds-doc-link:hover { color: var(--accent-hover, #254764); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-doc-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #355e83); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-doc-link strong { font-size: 1.6rem; } } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-doc-link { font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Uncertain feedback
components.description: A polite status message explaining that the result needs checking.
components.html: The device’s current status could not be confirmed. Reconnect through USB setup to check it before making another change.
components.css: .ds-uncertain { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; margin: 20px 0; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--warning-bg, #fff5e6); color: var(--warning-text, #805719); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-uncertain { font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Error feedback
components.description: A polite status message with a concrete recovery instruction.
components.html: The device disconnected. Reconnect the USB data cable and start again.
components.css: .ds-error { font-family: 'Mukta Malar', sans-serif; margin: 20px 0; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff0ec; color: #8a3426; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-error { font-size: 18px; } }

narrative.overview:
OpenAthan is a welcoming, practical open-source project. Its website uses generous humanist type, a white canvas and quiet rules to make project information, documentation and setup tasks easy to find. The text-only wordmark gives the project a clear identity without a separate symbol or decorative imagery.

Charcoal carries the reading hierarchy; slate blue identifies links and actions. Pale blue panels group supporting information, while amber calls attention to availability and uncertain outcomes. Pages remain flat and direct, with visible contribution paths and space for useful explanations.
keyCharacteristics: A text-only OpenAthan wordmark and one humanist sans-serif family.
Charcoal reading text, slate-blue actions and a white canvas.
Fine rules and pale supporting panels instead of shadows.
Explicit page, section and task headings with narrow-screen layouts.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use the darker field outline for controls and the lighter rule for noninteractive separators.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Render OpenAthan as text in the established bold sans-serif; do not add a separate brand symbol.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve hierarchy with type, spacing, rules and tonal panels; keep these components free of decorative shadows.

dos: Do use the text-only wordmark and the self-hosted regular/bold type family.
Do give supporting content pale panels and primary reading content white space.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, explanatory feedback and responsive heading hierarchy.
Do distinguish availability notices, errors and uncertain outcomes with words as well as color.
Do keep functional connection diagrams close to the instructions they explain.
donts: Don't add a symbol logo, decorative hero imagery or a competing display typeface.
Don't replace field outlines with the low-contrast separator color.
Don't add decorative shadows, pill controls or animated page transitions to these components.
Don't hide the release gate or style an unavailable installer action as enabled.
Don't use visual design or simulator behavior as evidence of physical installer qualification.
